# E0423: a when tests the presence of a field it also reads

A condition that reads an optional field concerns only the instances that
have it, so testing its presence as well says nothing more. Drop the presence
test; to test presence alone, name the field bare.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
	count?: int
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		name:  v0_0.name
		count: _drop(v0_0.count)
	}
	lacunas: {
		count: [{
			type:    DroppedField
			message: "a large count is gone"
			when:    v0_0.count != _|_ && v0_0.count > 10
		}]
	}
}

BackwardLens: {
	v1_0: _
	v0_0: {
		name: v1_0.name
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	name: string
}
```

thema reports:

 --> history/1.0.thema:9:10

  |                ^^^^^
